literal: Virtuous deeds and, abundant wealth and, other deeds and, woman's command with those who carry out, do not exist.
translation: Virtuous deeds, abundant wealth, and other worthy pursuits of life will not be found with those who blindly carry out the commands of their wives.
modern: மனைவியின் ஏவலுக்குப் பணிந்து நடப்பவர்களிடம் அறச்செயல்களும், சிறந்த செல்வமும், இன்பம் தரும் பிற நற்செயல்களும் இருக்காது.
explanation: This couplet warns against being entirely subservient to one's wife's commands. It states that a man who merely obeys his wife's biddings loses three key aspects of a fulfilled life: 'aṟaviṉai' (virtuous deeds), 'āṉṟa poruḷ' (abundant wealth), and 'piṟaviṉai' (other meaningful actions or pleasures). The word 'ēval' means command or bidding, highlighting that blind obedience destroys a man's independent capacity to perform his duties and earn respect.
